title: 日本ダービーの後に・誰かの夢の次は

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky deals with her frustrating loss in the Japanese Derby, the second race of the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At the same time, Special Week, whose dream was crushed, is consumed by regret. But she quickly begins to burn with renewed passion for the next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky sees this display of strength as a challenge. We continue on our path to the Kikuka Sho, the final Classic Triple Crown race.
